releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Count to Ten EP
releases.description:
"These tracks relentlessly force you to count to 10! or 5! or 20! It's fascinating." --RandomPunter

Caleb Bird, aka Biobird's latest EP, "Count to Ten", showcases a further exploration into the 5/4 time signature, a beat structure which Caleb has been experimenting with for quite some time. 

In his previous releases on Section 8's sister label, Section 8 Bass, we've noticed a progression of Caleb's sound, from 70-174 bpm tracks in multiple time signatures, a sound which we've decided to graduate and put on the front-line of Section 8's infantry.

Caleb's goal with these tracks has been to push the boundaries of the current meta of dubstep and DnB.

"This EP has been my biggest boundary pusher yet. Popular electronic dance music seems to always be in 4/4, and so I wanted to try and make some tracks that people can still groove to, whilst being in an odd time signatures."

Each track in this hard hitting, 5-track bundle reels you in with distant atmosphere and bass vibrations which escalate into a frenzy of drum edits, ominous melody, and fast-paced beats.
	
Caleb says Biobird started when he branched out into composing electronic music, which was a pivot from his time in high school composing pieces for guitar and other acoustic instruments.

"The ability to create your own instruments in electronic music, to build the guitar first and then play it, drew me in.. and then years of expermenting lead me to create the sounds I was after."

Caleb's influences from culture and art are wide but most notably he mentions, Mik Gordon, sound designer of award-winning video games like DOOM, and the infamous Hans Zimmers, who's best known for his integrating electronic music sounds with traditional orchestral arrangements in many films like Bladerunner. Also bands like Radiohead, Gojira, Meshuggah, and even Slipknot are among the mentionable influences early on while cultural influences include Maori, Norse, and Flamenco music which has influenced the scales and pitch arrangement in Caleb's music.

This is just the start. Caleb plans to continue experimenting saying, "5/4 seemed to be a good middle ground to start from and the DnB had the tempo that fit it the best. Having a steady flow is critical in dance music, so people can focus on doing their thing, not have to consciously keep themselves in the groove. I experimented with different time signatures and tempos and found that. I found that anything below ~160bpm the phrases would drag too much. With this decided, the main challenge of the EP, would be to create grooves that are clear and easy to follow. This in mind I set out to create tracks that were unique and danceable."

Two of Denver's most active members of the local DNB scene via Recon, Design & X-TS make their Section8 debut with a dynamic single. The b-side also features Recon resident, X-TS EMCEE on a track entitled 'Predicament'. 

The emcee, Justin Brathwaite aka X-TS has been a prominent figure in the Denver drum and bass circuit, known for his meaningful and subtle approach as a lyricist often describing his personal struggles in life while using a foundational approach when transcribing of his daily thoughts to unique lyrical form.

releases.title: The Prologue EP
releases.description:
This 6-track release is quite nicely nestled between tech and minimal flavors.  

Track 1.) "Divine Entity" is a deep techy roller laced with nice atmospherics. Quite a junky non-traditional placement on the drums which I quite like.  

Track 2.) "Sent from 94" brings about more techy drumwork with a number of psychedelic  sounds tying it all together.  Quite a moody track with enough kick and sub-bass to give it dancefloor appeal. 

Track 3.) "Fan The Flames" turns into a quite unexpected twist away from the other tracks. A nice halftime vibe with some great tribal feeling percussive elements. Another dancefloor tune for the deep heads.  

Track 4.) "Conspire" has the full-on jungle treatment with strewn with ragga vocal samples and lovely lead into the breakdown which maintains interest and anticipation for the next drop.

Track 5.) "Envy, Lust, And Low Cunning" starts off quite eerie in the vocal department lined with some nice strings and bass'd out synth lead and a comfy drum break.

Track 6.) "Harlot" goes deep and autonomic.  The chattering of jamaica can be heard in the background pulling the track nicely together in a loop that could entrance the dance floor chin strokers. Quite an original sounding piece.

In this round we showcase Adrians's "Murder Music" EP which shows off a unique and improvised play on percussion edits and grime influenced growling basslines.  Fans of Bar9, Megalodon, Stenchman, SPL, and BARE will truly appreciate what this EP brings to the table.

releases.title: Flammable Materials Compilation
releases.description:
Some new blood has made its way through Section 8 camp. Dark and twisted music.

Scholl iw'rem am sin. Ruffen Hämmel et och, Mecht Biereg d'Wise oft um. Mat jo sinn Hémecht d'Vioule, sin brommt grouss Plett'len fu. Bänk Schied jo dat, da Hämmelsbrot Nuechtegall dén. Ke Fréijor d'Vullen gei, et derfir heescht Hemecht déi.

Keng aremt Klarinett wat ke, en rou Schiet laanscht, an bei stét sëtzen gehéiert. Hu och drun aremt Gesträich. Net d'Loft Schiet am, méi hu ston Dall. An sin Dach virun beschéngt, nët ze sinn Himmel blëtzen, erwaacht Gesträich do dat. Stolz rëscht d'Kamäiner am wee, dan ze Land d'Margréitchen. Botze d'Wise gudden fu dat, jo get Fläiß erwaacht, Bass méngem dén ke.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Coil Burn
releases.description:
"Coil Burn" is Ruffian's debut release on Section 8 Recordings - a pounding audio assault, kicking in heads and destroying speakers. But don't be afraid...Death turns all to ash.

Ruffian and Ben Matrix are storming the gates with a two-pronged attack: "Standard Protocol" is a bass-heavy stomper that will make your guts quiver, and "Mobile Infantry" rolls out the hard and dark neuro vibes.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Aerokin / Huff
releases.description:
Making Aerokin was probably one of the most brain straining tunes of mine ever. Reason why was that in production I don't really focus on what key my tune is or the structure, I just GO. 

What got me with this tune is that i would get caught in-between keys and it would sound "good". still not sure what the keys are but i managed to bring both keys together in my opinion . 

While making the tune I envisioned a KOROKat head floating about in the city, which is why it sounds a bit airy and movemented. Besides sampling a couple vocal samples and hits, the real sounding strings and instruments all come from inside ableton and modulating string pads. Being the first tune I've made that blends two keys as such, it def has a special place in my heart.

Going from strength to strength Adrian is banging out all kinds of material, and this LP is just a teaser of what's to come.  Expect some big heavy dancefloor bass and choppy grimey rhythms and drum work.

releases.label: section8recs

releases.description: RedCell's debut release on Section 8 features two bass heavy steppers made for the dancefloor -- quality drum treatments lined with proper subbass frequencies.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Genocide / Edward Bad Man Bernays
releases.description:
I really love talking up the deeper darker side of music.. and this new one from Sick Cycle has got me EXTREMELY excited about their return to Section 8 -- This new 2-track single precedes much more on the way!   

"Genocide" reminds us of the early sounds of Sick Cycle  -- "Mutate" and "Deceit" from earlier works come to mind -- still holding their original appeal.  

Then we have "Edward Bad Man Bernays"  -- a deep yet dancefloor-ready groove-filled tune.  Have a listen and you will understand what this tune could do for a dancefloor who are caught ridin the vibe more and more these days. Definite attention-getter.

Now the original is available in highest of quality. Fans of Limewax, Current Value, Forbidden Society will appreciate this one! Don't sleep on this!

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Full Throttle Remixes
releases.description: The magical 50th release for Section 8 Drum and Bass is a hard hitting one -- fittingly back to the roots of what originated this label. Brainpain's ominous relentless beats from his original well-received 'Full Throttle' EP have been refixed and remixed for fans who like their drums pounding and their bass quaking. Hardstep you can count on.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Bad Poetry
releases.description: A deeply disturbing contribution from Denver-based production duo Goreteks provides some insight into the dark underbelly of American drum and bass. Not content with frat party soundsystems and bass-driven beer pong, DJs Baloo and Strode bashed their heads together to create "Bad Poetry", an old-school roundhouse smash to the face with added horror movie atmospherics. "Blesser Au L'Esprit" tricks out tense, minimal atmospherics with some seriously impressive severe breaks again with that same old-school spirit. Keep your eyes on these two, with a kick starter like this they are surely destined for big things.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Triton Remixes
releases.description: A remix pack of the well received deep and dark track "Triton" by Olie Bassweight.  This release features a variety of styles applied to the original track featuring remixes from talented new artists on Section8 -- BAKU, FIZIK, KAKAPO, TONG8, REUBEN G-RAY, EARTH IS OUR SPACESHIP.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Remorse Code / The Lacking
releases.description:
Two bangers from Quentin Hiatus and Turnstyle. "Remorse Code" is a glitchy melodic yet gritty dubstep track with a double-time kick which keeps things interesting and steppy. The b-side, "The Lacking" is also a gritty track but with a rolling squared out bassy synth-line and a short classic diva vocal line. Two unique tracks for the dance floor.

ALTERNATE UPC 616983938881

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Knowledge EP
releases.description: Clean yet dark rhythmic textures and chest rattling bass across the board -- Jakub23's debut Section 8 release brings quality production to the table with the A-side track collaboration with talented lyricist Ol-e Mac dropping the lyrical "Knowledge" on the track. "Father Frederick" -- the b-side starts off a 150 bpm half-time mellow stepper with ragga vocals strewn through the track giving it that classic jungle vibe but with a glitchy twist on the up-front dnb rhythm that takes hold at the drop. "Encarta" is kick heavy drum and bass roller lined with Jakub23's signature glitchy nuance. Quality music through-n-through.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Hooligans EP
releases.description: Put away your wimpy laptop speakers and fire up the bassbins. That's the only way to experience dubstep like this properly. Here are 4 heavy sub-bass tracks from Sqz Me.  Made for dark dancefloors with creeping basslines and minimalistic drums.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Dubrime / Sleepy Hollow
releases.description: Section 8 is known for dancefloor smashers and new up and coming artists. Cottonmouth's sound is no exception. Two well constructed growling dubstep tunes give us a taste of what's to come from this artist and this label in 2013.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Filthy Rhythms 3
releases.description: Continuing the onslaught with this filthy rhythms series. This is part 3 of the series. Featuring filthy drum and bass works from Proton Kid, Hardlogik, Neomind, Unsub, A-Tech, KRIEG + Snyde, Circular Discharge, Taos, and Neomind.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Machines / Gut Wrench
releases.description: Opening up with "Machines" -- a heavy half time techy grinder.  The b-side "Gut Wrench" takes a more traditional approach to heavy tech influenced drum and bass.

releases.description: Pure darkness and heavy bass -- Part 1 of this epic double EP features some of the freshest drum and bass artists on the Section 8 roster and it's perfect timing for the beginning of the 2012 Winter apocalypse. Also be sure to check out Part 2 for some equally nasty dubstep!

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Haunted EP 2012 pt.2
releases.description: Pure darkness and heavy bass. Part 2 of this epic EP features some of the freshest dubstep artists on the Section 8 roster.  Perfect timing for the beginning of the 2012 Winter apocalypse.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Big Step Forward / Double Ducker
releases.description: The 3rd continuation of the 2012 minimal series of releases on Section 8. LeStR on this release has some tracks fitting for a dungeon scene -- dark halftime/minimal drum and bass and dubstep. Both tracks perfect for a minimal set of any genre.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Three / Incarnate
releases.description: Continuing the minimal sub-bass series here, Insatek (UK) delivers a dark steppy sub-bass single.  Both tracks are fitting for any type of minimal broken beat bass music set.

releases.label: section8recs

releases.description: A deep "Bushido" Samurai-influenced minimal release from Tomasz Szlachcic aka "Self Definition" out of Poland. Deep sub-bass halftime drum and bass, dubstep. Quality.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Find You EP
releases.description: Get ready!  Russian duo, Dmitriy Svirgunov and Ilya Gadaev aka "The Neft", return with some highly energetic music in the flavor of 140 BPM.  Epic intros give way to heavy melodic drops and lush strings. Great drum-work and an overall show of talent from these guys.  This is just the start of what these two musical maestros are capable of.  Be sure to also check their recent deep dubstep releases on Plush Recordings.

releases.description: Yes Yes, LeStR and Bookinz bringing back the heavy nosebleed drum and bass onslaught... PROPER DANCEFLOOR SMASHERS!

releases.title: Tooth Monster
releases.description: Track-A is a 150BPM guitar-ridden rave track from Criss Hathaway & Pyro.. I believe it to be the crowd favorite on this release. The tempos and beats put your mix somewhere between drumstep and dubstep so this could also be a really great cross-over track if you mix up your stles a lot. The b-side has definitely proven to be a great dj tool for us. This gritty instrumentals track is a wicked way to creative cutting and slices in the mix.  Recommended.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Like This
releases.description:
This smashing and diverse tune has  gotten huge response all across the globe with heavy support from the top including Hatcha, N-Type, Plastician and a slew more. 

Originally debuted on Target's BBC 1XTRA show, Doctor's pristine grime vocal studio work makes this track  accompany a heavy sub-bass signature sound you can only get from musicians who immerse their lives into dubstep and spend time developing their own style. Those such musicians are Megalodon and Conscious Pilot. 

"Like This" is available on 12" vinyl from various online and real-life retail outlets.  Check the label website for more info.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Exclusive Dubplates Spring 2012
releases.description: These tracks are not due out as singles until later 2012 but you can download now via this exclusive promo from Section 8.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Hardcore Vibes
releases.description: Whether you like dubstep or drum and bass matters not. We're all friends here right? Well either way, these tracks bring the two together... unashamedly... representing the full on bass assault you can always expect from this very talented producer group. This is KOYA.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Quest / Music Box
releases.description: Bison is back with his new 100BPM sound files.  Both tracks seem to be a continuance from his previous orchestra-based instrumentals in "Dawn of Evolution" but this time at a slower tempo. Fans of glitch-hop, dubstep, and moobahcore will appreciate the steppy rhythms in this release.  Perhaps the most unique is the b-side "Music Box" which will give you visions of a half broken music box opening up and revealing amputated puppets coming alive and dancing about. Instrumental experimentation at it's finest!

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Mind Games / Wailing Death
releases.description: Heavy doesn't even begin to describe the darkness of this release.  "Mind Games" is suprisingly simple yet effectively bass heavy and dacefloor smasher material.  You can keep people skanking with this tune no problem! It is an essential glue for a solid heavy set. The b-side "Wailing Death" is a similar story but still unique with a nice long maxed-out intro that draws you in and roaring bass and samples at the drop.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Sorrow Meets Chaos
releases.description:
Russian born 'Igor Chekmarev' is OK. His debut song 'Sorrow' is a jump into the the deep end of Dub Step. Punchy beats and the airy feel to the beginning leaves you no inclination of the chaos to come. Whirling, zippy beats and breaks. Though dark and intense it has such a stark element of light. One minute drifting and floating. The next sensory overload. So much happens within the tune, you hardly know if you're coming or going. But it works. Such a perfect balance of dark and light we love it.

B side 'Chaos' is the debut song a collaboration from Russian artist's 'Incept' and 'Kexx'. On first impression 'Chaos' is damn right. But far from chaotic this tune has a clever use of light and dark. The deep menacing intro doesn't even begin to let you in on the hard, militant barrage of sounds bombarding you from the outset. But then you're taken away by the light, airy breaks. Which only serve to intensify the onslaught of wonderfully dirty beats. Another ingenious tune with such a great balance of light and dark which will leave any hardcore nosebleed Dubstepper wanting more.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment Compilation 2
releases.description: In 2011, Section8Recs found a huge number of talented artists who met the match of creating destruction through sound. The series, entitled "Tech Treatment", showcased some unique uses of heavy break influenced drum and bass with floor pounding kicks and growling basslines to boot.This compilation summarizes that series and adds a few new tracks into the mix.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: The Mad Lands
releases.description:
Denver based John Sullivan aka BAD LOGIK known for the infamous JungleLabs warehouse parties, has continued to push the boundries of cross genre electronic music. Signed to Section 8 Recs with a string of upfront bass-driven tracks, it seemed only fair to give some fresh talent a chance to air their skills by giving them a shot at remixing one of his sonic offerings!

Here you'll find an eclectic variation of 5 remixes from the competition finalists, bringing flavors ranging from deep EDM and dubstep, to hard techy glitch and "crunktronica", all focused on the styles that you would expect from a Section 8 release and making original track, "The Mad Lands", just that little bit more insane with this fresh spread of bass excursions.

releases.description: "762" is the new solo project of Westy of Sick Cycle (Rottun Records / Section 8 Recordings).  This particular release is halftime dnb / full-on techstep drum and bass venture.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: The Dawn of Evolution
releases.description:
BISON aka RYAN SMITH, hails from southern UK. Big, bad, and heavy bass is the style of this badmon producer and he has gotten dj support from the likes of Excision, Downlink, Culprate, Basher, Tomba, Borgore, Koldfront, Hulk, Jae Kennady, and more...  This particular release perhaps one of the momentous of all he has ever done.  Dreamy melody lined with refined and original sounding sawtooth bass.

DJ Support from:
Adroa, Hulk, Downlink, Excision, Mark Instinct, 6blocc, Culprate, Suspect,  Diode, Endboss, Nightbreed, Basher, Jae Kennady, Excision, Krew, Shadow-Conspiracy, Koldfront, Dioptrics, An0dyne, Wicked Sway & Melamin, Optical (Ed Rush & Optical)

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Split Mind EP
releases.description:
The robot voices in the head of iBenji say "kill kill kill" and voices in our head say "yes yes yes". Russian producer, iBenji, steps up again and brings with him three other masters of bass manipulation: Oceania, Saint Rider, and Tim Ismag -- all who in recent months have risen up from the dark reaches of underground music to join ranks among the modern elite to impose their own influence on the sound.

DJ support from Itchy Robot, Hulk, Tim Ismag and more...

tracks.title: Tales From The Darkside (Tim Ismag Remix)

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Haunted EP Sampler
releases.description: While "Got Damn Candy" may as well be a song about Halloween, this 19 track sampler is full of various tempos forthcoming on Section 8, a label that is well known for bringing a haunted, eerie, and funky vibe to the table -- This one is fiitting for a bloody night out.

tracks.title: Tales from the Darkside (Tim Ismag Remix)

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Interim / Red Water
releases.description: Quality production from a man that is making his way up the ranks in the dnb and dubstep world.  Quentin Hiatus is a name destined for big things and a name to look out for!  The a-side is a smasher bass dancefloor assault, while the b-side is a deep rolling pleasant ride.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Future Darkness EP
releases.description: The Section8 crew continue their assault on the bass music market with an absolute dynamite EP package that spreads itself across the full dubstep spectrum. From lip-smacking sound system bangers and dance floor clangers through to gnarly experimental bass excursions for more discerning ears, this one is sure to appeal with a huge array of new talent on offer. Section8 getting serious!!

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Flippant Funk
releases.description:
Complex instrumentals lined with danceable new form funk. 

Jimmy Thomas (Electromass) started from the UK Bigbeat scene gathering many styles and ideals which have now set him up to master the art of darker edged dubstep and experimental instumentals.

His interest in the mechanics of electronic music began early -- writing drum patterns in all styles and gaining knowledge from profressional drummers in the scene who have helped him develop his sound since his early years.

His newest single, "Flippant Funk" is a de-emphasis on melody but empasis on strong rhythmic grooves and electric bass,  An admixture of influences including drummer Bernard Perdie, and musicians such as early Chemical Brothers and Amon Tobin.  This particular release in fact has an Amon Tobin-esque experimental breaks feel to it ... yet you also get a sense of deep hiphop rooted drum breaks and sampled jazz funk compositions of various natures,.. Both tracks focus around the half-time 90BPM shuffle and are very mixable with drum and bass and hiphop.. either way a definite good way to "funk up" a mix when you need to.  Recommended.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: D.A.T.
releases.description: 'D.A.T's gonna get ya! Aka Dark And Terrifying is exactly  that with an eerie drifting intro with horror fx, synth stabs and a dangerous vocal that signals the gnarliest of drops...then we're off! Booming subs with a seriously funked up syncopated riff go off like a machine gun taking no prisoners as we roll out into a big room dubstep dance floor destroyer. Very cool indeed.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Aerophobia
releases.description:
Onwards and upwards for the Section8 clan as they get ready to deliver possibly their biggest release to date with a mighty, thunderous dubstep assault from one of Bristol's brightest up & coming production duos, Dodge & Fuski. Having built up quite a reputation already with some killer releases on labels such as Never Say Die and Rat, this one looks set to earn them even more attention; get ready for the sound system bangers!    

Ethereal pads open up 'Aerophobia' before an epic, grandiose synth enters the mix to set the scene for what's to come and you'd better be ready because it's quite simply, sick! Watch the dance go crazy as we kick into an absolutley heinous bass riff that grabs by the throat and doesn't let go with a smashing break holding it all together. It only goes on to get even better with a totally funked up 4/4 switch up too! More bassline manipulation ensues and the dubstep break returns to complete what's sure to be a massive club anthem. A lot of fun.    

Onto the flip and the tranced-out intro vibe continues with another awe-inpsiring arrangement of twinkling synths and FX on 'Fuck 'Em All'. Wait for the drop though of turbo-charged surging low-end comes to conquer with an attitude-laden vocal that won't see this one getting any radio play anytime soon....though the ravers are gonna love it and that's really what this is all about. Bangin'!

**RadioOne 1xtra made a mistake and titled the a-side as "Dodge & Fusty - Aeroplane".

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Groef / Lateral Clique
releases.description: Technical rhythms and pads that draw you in. The A side is on the minimal tip but has some deeeep heavy bass behind the track.  The B side is techo influenced dnb or otherwise known as "technoid".  Classic feel and sounds in this track make will get people boogying down on the dance floor.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Filthy
releases.description: 2 filthy heavy tracks and a breaky dance tune at the end. Not much else to say.  They hit the spot for us.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Filthy Rhythms Vol1
releases.description: Some of the darkest tunes we have come across as of late.  These artists mainly focused on the drum breaks snare and rhythm programming rather than the bass.  Still, you will want to turn up your subs and get those low frequencies shakin your walls.  A gem release for dark hearts. A+

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Shy Flame
releases.description:
Taking the honours and heading up the release is SPL with his awesome take on 'Shy Flame', twisting it into a nasty piece of synthetic filth that's bound  to cause maximum damage in the club. Intro'ing with heavily filtered vocals that float in the mix of drifting pads it's not long before the stabbing church-like synth builds us up for the drop of bassline murder! Pummelling subs double down as SPL draws us deep into the journey for a huge piece of dubstep which aims to please. Wait for the middle section switch and it's all over! 

Moving on to  Current Value's orginial 'Shy Flame' featuring his favoured vocalist  Snow and it's a very different story; a drum & bass story to be exact. Opening with a light stepping break, Snow's vocals begin to wash over the arrangement as we assume the position. It's then a soft drop into the full on break and the square wave b-line that leads the way as the track develops gradually into a full-on piece of big-room rave. Double kicks keep things rolling to the end as the dreaming pads envelope the mix. Quality gear.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: The Power EP
releases.description: The A-side "Seems" is such a wicked track. It is a fusion of hiphop and dubstep elements in the perfect combination.  The remaining two tracks "The Power" and "Fuck Yeah" conform to the traditional dubstep style but are powerful dancefloor mashup tunes in the right hands.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: System Overload
releases.description: Brainpain's pounding bass is no joke.  We tested these out on a proper system and drinks were rattling off the table!  A heavy drumstep remix accompanies the original.

releases.title: Night City / Panic Attack
releases.description: Minimal techy rollers. Quality production!

`Wicked!` --Hard2Flip

`BOOOMMMM!!!`  --Niveau Zero

releases.description:
Having released much material on many labels like Culture Assault, Gamma Audio, Black Hoe, Pavillon36, and Cyber Crunk; and now making his debut on Section8 ValkyR has put a piece of his mind into each of these moody dark melodies.

Quality pieces of work!

releases.label: section8recs

releases.description: Heavy bass and kicks.  These tracks are unique and HARRRRD.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 8: B.H.
releases.description: Technoid sounds all the way.  This release is a banger from the mighty B.H.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 7: The Dizphonics
releases.description: Tripped out steppy breaks lined with some gnarly bassline switch-ups and eerie synth pads.  Great dancefloor brock-out material.  Tech-step meets techno meets neuro hardstep.

releases.label: section8dub

releases.description: Heading up his own record label, Oblivion Fringe, Alert focuses on dark electronic music, sometimes with a sadistic/class clown sense of humor thrown in for good measure.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Floppy Sausage / Artifact
releases.description: Intelligent rhythms and filthy grinding bass.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Smoke & Mirrors EP
releases.description: There's a shadowy underground cult lurking in the darkness of dubstep music and Sick Cycle is synonymous with it's soundtrack.  A haunted moody synth opener, entitled 'Deceit' (a-side) provides the perfect intro for 3 groovy and heavily breaks oriented Dubstep dark rollers, 'Murmur' (b-side), '7.62mm' (c), and 'Change'(d).

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 6: Forbidden Society
releases.description: Forbidden Society's dark history starts in 1996, when he started producing breakcore, a niche genre characterized by it's hard fast straight pounding rhythm and relentless sub-bass.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Crazy Monk / Skunk Machine
releases.description: Two new intelligently put together dubstep tunes from the one like, Benji. These tunes have just the right twist of grimey bassline.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Critical Reject / Slumberfunk
releases.description: Straight to the dark vibes on this release, The Sinister Souls are a producers-duo hailing from the city of Utrecht (The Netherlands). Their music contains elements of Drum â€˜n Bass, Breakcore, Techno and Dubstep. Variation is a key element, no moments of dozing off with these tracks.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 5: Genetic Killers
releases.description: Clean heavy drum and bass, technoid style!

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Space Ninja / Wobble Aliens
releases.description: Tim Ismag (Timur Ismagilov) -- longtime Musician, Producer of Dubstep, Drum And Bass, IDM, House is a master craftsman in dub.  These two tunes although harmonic still have a foundation of bass that will rumble any dancefloor to the ground.  Dancefloor tested and approved. These tunes are getting some big support right now!

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: BioElectric / Haters / Rugged and Raw
releases.description: RumbleJunkie (Denver, CO) has been making a scene of brutality in the US dubstep arena.  His works are trimmed with a side of melody and structure while keeping bassbins rumbling the dance floor.  Starting out as a drum and bass dj/producer he has found a true knack for dubstep production.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 4: kr4y
releases.description: kr4y (Bristol) has recently been gaining some attention from various parts of the internet dnb scene. In this release he delivers what we like to call 'intelligent-techno-infused-dnb'. Various technoid flavors and even a half time 170bpm track to switch things up.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Adrenalina
releases.description: John Sullivan (aka Bad Logik), Denver, Colorado is partly responsible for the infamous JungleLabs venture known by many in Denver for their packed out warehouse parties bring fresh live glitch acts in the late pre-2010 era. This man has some excellent pieces of audio artwork we are showcasing this year with slews of fresh material from glitch hop to dubstep, to drum and bass.  This set of tunes are sure to make an impact on your senses.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Mr. Bubbles / Kill Me
releases.description: Benji brings forth a new release showcasing his masterful oscillation of dubstep wobble bass.  Two moody and step-friendly tunes that are tried and tested on the dance floor.  For the video game lovers -- Mr. Bubbles contains some cleer usae of `Bioshock 2` samples and the b-side track, `Kill Me` features samples from Quake 2.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 3: Sin City/The Spot
releases.description: Tensa sets the mood of blackness with these military death march style rhythms.  Heavy grinding bass littered with cleverly syncopated percussion throughout.

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Miraculum
releases.description: Polish producers Brainpain and Sicknote team together bringing some heavy sounds that are so popular in Eastern Europe.  Two versions of the tune are available in dubstep and drum and bass.  We find it hard to decide which one is our favorite.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Tech Treatment 2: Taos
releases.description: Taos has come forth and brought some hard stomping drum and bass tunes resembling the mentality of a psychopath. Plenty of edits and glitched out effects keep these tunes interesting and the bass frequencies in these tunes are made to get the the dance floor rumbling.  Any lovers of Counterstrike, Cooh, Audio will surely love this release!

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Villain EP
releases.description: If you like dark dirty dubstep this is the EP for you.  Some great artists on this one. From dark rolling basslines to tweaked out fidgity edits.

releases.label: section8recs
releases.title: Edge of Dreams
releases.description: A gem from 2009... limited quantities available on vinyl (if you look around for it).

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Hell's Winter
releases.description: Brand new dubstep release from New Zealand's death bass outfit, Sick Cycle including a remix of Hell's Winter by metal band Scream Machine.1

releases.label: section8dub
releases.title: Motherfucking Big Fat Bass
releases.description: These two tunes are made to be dancefloor smashers and they are!
